Players Committee card image of [[Deflector Shield Generators (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploy on a capital starship. Starship is power and armor +2 and immune to attrition < 5. May cancel Combined Attack or Power Pivot targeting this starship. Starfighters here may not 'attach.'”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/deflectorshieldgenerators.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb53af72c4491442a863d743950ff8a472ed77b3 eb53af7] (1 December 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
